ecr_scope: SQL Injection at DVWA and XVWA; XSS at DVWA, XVWA, bWAPP, and OWASP Juice Shop; Command Injection at DVWA, XVWA, and bWAPP; Path Traversal and LFI at DVWA and XVWA; Open Redirect at XVWA and OWASP Juice Shop. bWAPP SQL excluded because its route yielded no usable oracle.
